description: The master collection of photographs. Each has a stable id that never changes and is never given to another photograph, even after it is removed (sheets.json 'retired'). src is the web copy under photography/ (sRGB JPEG, about 2560 px on the long edge); w and h are its real size; alt is approved alt text; added is the date it reached the site. color is kept for the old folio scripts; the room reads tone from photo-meta.json. The file order decides no public order.
